Package pt.pa.ui

Class DisplayHelper

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.ui.DisplayHelper
public class DisplayHelper extends Object
A helper class for the JavaFX UI nodes. It applies styles, hides and shows elements, generates colorful squares and others.
